title: IBFM: Invariant-Based Fusion Module
description:
PyTorch implementation of the Invariant-Based Fusion Module (IBFM), a channel attention module for visible-infrared fusion that describes the feature map of each channel with a vector of moment invariants (statistical, Hu or Zernike).

Code of the paper: K. Palapanidis, T. Tsikrika, K. Ioannidis, S. Vrochidis and I. Kompatsiaris, "Invariant-Based Channel Attention for Robust Visible-Infrared Fusion Under Sensor Degradation", IEEE Access, vol. 14, 2026, doi: 10.1109/ACCESS.2026.3706896.
